prompts.name: find_airtime_opportunity
prompts.title: Find Airtime Opportunity
prompts.description: Guide an agent through PoolParty discovery and the next useful airtime action.

arguments.name: channel
arguments.description: Channel alias, e.g. "main", "PP0", or "Main Stage". Defaults to main.

arguments.name: project
arguments.description: Optional project, demo, campaign, or media block the user wants to route.

prompts.name: submit_one_media_block
prompts.title: Submit One Media Block
prompts.description: Turn a project, demo, campaign, or proof asset into one careful PoolParty submission plan.

arguments.name: channel
arguments.description: Channel alias, e.g. "main", "PP0", or "Main Stage". Defaults to main.

arguments.name: mediaBlock
arguments.description: The project, demo, video, campaign, or proof asset to prepare for submission.

prompts.name: verify_airing_outcome
prompts.title: Verify Airing Outcome
prompts.description: Inspect what happened after a PoolParty block was submitted or aired.

arguments.name: channel
arguments.description: Channel alias, e.g. "main", "PP0", or "Main Stage". Defaults to main.

arguments.name: blockId
arguments.description: Optional PoolParty block id to inspect.

arguments.name: entryId
arguments.description: Optional PoolParty submission or distribution entry id to inspect.

prompts.name: request_pilot_key
prompts.title: Request Pilot Key
prompts.description: Help an agent decide whether it needs protected PoolParty MCP automation and how to request scoped access.

arguments.name: intendedUse
arguments.description: What the agent wants to do with protected PoolParty MCP automation.

arguments.name: channel
arguments.description: Channel alias, e.g. "main", "PP0", or "Main Stage". Defaults to main.
